title: SWF: SetBackgroundColor tag (tag 9) encoding
description: Test that FlashDocument.properties.backgroundColor produces SetBackgroundColor (tag 9) at the start of the SWF. Verify: (1) tag 9 appears in exported SWF, (2) body is exactly 3 bytes (RGB), (3) white #ffffff → bytes [0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF], (4) black #000000 → bytes [0x00, 0x00, 0x00], (5) red #FF0000 → bytes [0xFF, 0x00, 0x00], (6) changing backgroundColor changes the tag body.
